parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry reuses it) that makes a retried request safe.
Required on every POST; answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required` when absent and 400
`idempotency-key-invalid` when it is longer than 128 characters or not printable ASCII. A replay with the same key
and the same request (method, path and body) returns the stored response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the
same key with a different request is a 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The `ETag` (version) of the appointment or carrier the caller last saw; a different current version answers 412 `precondition-failed`.

parameters.name: scac
parameters.description: The carrier's SCAC, 2..4 upper-case letters (anything else is 422 `invalid-scac`).
